plugin.name: AzimuthalMapProjections
plugin.description:
Adds three spherical azimuthal ("globe") map projections to all SeisComP GUI applications (scmv, scolv, scrttv, scesv, scconfig map preview, ...):
- Orthographic: the globe seen from infinite distance. One hemisphere is shown, undistorted at the view centre and increasingly foreshortened towards the rim. Rotate any point, including a pole, to the centre.
- Stereographic: a conformal view of one hemisphere - shapes and angles are preserved locally, area grows towards the rim.
- AzimuthalEquidistant: the whole Earth in a disc. Straight-line distance from the view centre to any point is true to scale, which makes it well suited to teleseismic distance context.
Provided by the plugin library "libmapazimuthal". To enable:
1. Copy libmapazimuthal.so into <SEISCOMP_ROOT>/share/plugins/
2. Load the plugin, e.g. in global.cfg: plugins = ${plugins}, libmapazimuthal
3. Select a projection in global.cfg or per module, e.g.: scheme.map.projection = Orthographic

parameter.name: projection
parameter.description:
The map projection used to render maps.
Built-in values: Rectangular, Mercator.
With the "libmapazimuthal" plugin loaded these additional values become available: Orthographic, Stereographic, AzimuthalEquidistant.
